claimChecks.claim: Quill, V-Loc and STRATAFIX require product-specific sizing and material descriptions
claimChecks.locator: Prior restoration report, Medtronic catalog fields, Corza configuration/sizing fields and J&J product-family section
claimChecks.note: Current page keeps product-specific distinctions; full IFUs and exact code/needle combinations remain unresolved.

claimChecks.claim: Pyeloplasty small-series failures and pooled redo RR are signals, not a universal ban or equivalence proof
claimChecks.locator: Prior abstract checks: Liatsikos n=6, Radford n=10 and Anand five-study pooled RR 6.00 (0.78-46.14)
claimChecks.note: Current page preserves both signals and favorable selected reports without a universal brand rule; original full packages are open.

claimChecks.claim: Gupta 82% versus 24% measures laboratory closure-system failure, not clinical renal closure failure
claimChecks.locator: Original abstract Methods/Results: 4-N saline tank, Lapra-Ty/Hem-o-Lok clip system, three-week test
claimChecks.note: Page identifies laboratory system failure, not patient failure; full test matrix/figures remain unread.

claimChecks.claim: Li 2015 found faster VUA suturing without a statistically significant difference in pooled leak or specified continence intervals
claimChecks.locator: Original main article Results, Table 2 and Discussion: 3 RCTs + 6 observational, n=786; leak 7.08% vs 3.37%, OR 2.17 (0.86-5.50)
claimChecks.note: Time-saving and non-significance supported; equivalence is not established and cannot transfer to graft quilting or ureter.

claimChecks.claim: Hu 2025 reported shorter warm-ischemia time in selected T1 RAPN patients, not a universal renal-function benefit
claimChecks.locator: Original Methods/Results and Tables 1-2: 25/arm selected T1 RAPN; WIT 11.76 vs 14.56 minutes
claimChecks.note: Page limits this to small selected trial and short-term outcomes; different closure systems and unviewed Table 3/supplements limit broader claims.

claimChecks.claim: Every barbed-suture-related bowel obstruction inevitably needs surgery and case reports supply incidence
claimChecks.locator: Original abstract Results/Conclusion: 18 reports plus 14 MAUDE records; authors' exploration conclusion
claimChecks.note: Management row scoped to reported cases; mechanism signal retained, no incidence inferred.

claimChecks.claim: No large denominator evidence exists for bowel entrapment, or zero observed cases proves zero risk
claimChecks.locator: Sassun publisher abstract Methods/Results: 20,260 exposed, 264 diagnosed obstruction, 102 obstruction reoperations, 279 total abdominal reoperations, none attributed
claimChecks.note: Added 2026 cohort beside earlier cases; no non-barbed control, paywalled full methods or blanket safety inference.

claimChecks.claim: All product-specific bench, animal, clinical and cross-field source packages have been validated
claimChecks.note: Original full methods/tables/figures, device IFUs and relevant operative media remain to be reviewed before clearance.
